test_title: SSC Selection Post Matric Level Official Paper (Held on: 2 Feb 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Read the given statements and conclusions carefully. Assuming that the information given in the statements is true, even if it appears to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the given conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements. 

**Statements:**

1. Some Birds are Insects. 

2. Some Insects are Animals. 

3. All Animals are Dangerous. 

**Conclusions:**

I. Some Animals are Birds. 

II. All Insects are Dangerous.

options.text: Neither conclusion I nor II follows.
Both conclusions I and II follow.

solution:
The least possible Venn diagram is given according to the given information.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0e1df74cc667672ba87fec16eec54ecd177a2e31c4b1902d443fc310ef1d9ed7.png] 

Conclusions:

I. Some Animals are Birds → Does not follow → (As some birds are insect, some insects are animals and all animals are dangerous. So, some animal are birds are possible but not definite)

II. All Insects are Dangerous → Does not follow → (As some insects are animal and all animal are dan
gerous. So, all insects are dangerous is possible but not definite)

Hence, the correct answer is **"Neither conclusion I nor II follows".**
